mission.title: Ring 149
mission.description: Find out why bluepills are turning up dead wherever Danielle Wright uses her overrides.

npc.say:
Hm?
...
I suggest you find something constructive to do.

We've never seen anything like this before, so I really can't say. A single pod tower can hold thousands of people. If the interface program really is there, and Wright keeps chasing it from host to host through the pods in the tower...we're looking at tens of thousands of people at risk.
You should do as Agent Stewart advised, Mr. {player}.
Get the hell out of here. This is your goddamn fault, you know.
If you were really concerned about the safety of these people, you'd have joined the System when Agent Gray offered you a place with us.

phase.briefing:
{player}, we have a new problem: bluepills are turning up dead across the city. We don't know exactly what's causing it, but override use has been detected in the vicinity of a few of the victims, so Wright seems like a prime suspect.
I'm calling you now because we've just picked up an override signal not far from your location. Please get there as quickly as you can.

enter.say: Dang, this looks like a big one. Watch yourself in there.

talk.say:
Well, pod 0026:05:0149:032, let's see if you're the one that program's chosen to call home...
Hmh. Unfortunately not. Someone else in 149, then.

done.say:
Did she think the interface program was in that bluepill? If she's going after bluepills now...this is bad.
Look, you'd better get outside and get ready to move. It sounds like she's going to go after more people; maybe we can follow her and prevent more deaths.

phase.briefing: Your operator's hunch may have been right, operative; Wright has changed her position to another residential area. I'm putting it up for you now.

enter.say: Damn, we can't beat her to the punch when she can just zap herself from spot to spot. Maybe she'll still be in the middle of some supervillainesque rant...

done.say: Damn it, I've lost Wright's signal. Damn, damn, damn!

phase.briefing:
Operative, we haven't been able to establish a connection between those two victims. However, Wright referred to the first as a "pod" number, and we think this could be significant: maybe she is looking for the program inside the Machine pod system in the Real, rather than just inside simulated RSIs.
We're going to try locating the last victim's pod. This requires alterations to the usual red pill procedure, since the subject is deceased... But if the Machines haven't flushed the body from its pod yet, it may work. Check in with operative Patch Daemon at our lab for an update. We've already had the corpse transferred there.

enter.say: Oh man... This is gruesome. It makes a sick kind of sense, though. We know Wright's an expert on the pod systems; she's the one who re-wrote our red pill extraction routine when the Machines cracked the original. If anyone would be able to follow the interface program though the pods, it'd be her. Now we've got to try to beat her at it, or she'll go on killing everyone in the whole pod cluster until she corners the program.

talk.say:
Ah, {player}. It seems to have worked; we're getting real-world coordinate information back from the pill trace now. Fortunately, their pod cluster appears to be relatively close to the Machine city. We've got a ship approaching it now.
Once the ship arrives, they'll be able to start running back-traces on the people in nearby pods. In theory, that gives us a chance to find them in the simulation before Wright does. That's where you'll come in.

phase.briefing: {player}, our crew at the tower says that it's just pods in the same horizontal pod ring that are...empty. For now, at least, that narrows our search down significantly. They've begun running traces back on the remaining people in that ring of pods. The location you see marked on your HUD should correspond to one of those bluepills.

enter.say:
Great, no override activity in sight. Our bluepill should be in...
Hold on... Those are Machine and redpill signals. Damn it, what now?

talk.say: This location has been secured...operative. Your continued presence here will result only in your arrest or termination, which would hardly be...efficient for anyone, would it?

done.say:
Damn it, they got to the bluepill already. And they think they're going to be able to protect them inside the pod system? Fat chance.
... Come on. Hanging around there isn't going to help any.

mission.finish:
{player}, we've lost contact with the hovercraft at the tower! Another ship in the vicinity is telling us they're picking up heavy Sentinel activity... It looks like the Machines have made their move.
We have no way to track those bluepills before Wright finds them, now. If Machines can't stop her, she could continue killing the rest of the people plugged into that tower; but if they can stop her, they may be able to trap the interface program there.
I'm afraid I have no more information for you now. I'll update you as soon as I have something.
